name: orchestrated-delivery-greenfield
description: Guided greenfield setup that recommends an orchestrated delivery workflow with project-shaping agents, skills, artifacts, and targets.

questions.prompt: What kind of project are you starting?

options.label: Microservice or platform project
options.reason: Recommended because this setup benefits from explicit requirements, architecture, implementation, review, QA, test, and orchestration states.

options.label: AI or LLM application
options.reason: Blocked in this guided setup because its generic composition does not include the dedicated AI evaluation gate. Use ai-application-greenfield for the standard AI delivery flow, or initialize a generic bundle directly when AI-specific evaluation is intentionally not required.

options.label: Library or package
options.reason: Compatible because implementation, review, and test agents are useful, but the generated setup may later be reduced when a library-specific setup exists.

options.label: Documentation-only project
options.reason: Blocked because this setup expects implementation, review, QA, and test artifacts. A documentation-specific setup should be registered separately.

questions.prompt: How should the work be controlled?

options.label: Orchestrated delivery
options.reason: Recommended because the workflow has explicit handoff states and artifact contracts from requirements through QA.

options.label: Review-heavy delivery
options.reason: Compatible because the current bundle includes CodeReviewer and QA, but a dedicated review-heavy workflow is not registered yet.

options.label: Test-first delivery
options.reason: Compatible because the current bundle includes TestRunner and test artifacts, but a dedicated test-first workflow is not registered yet.

options.label: Ad-hoc prompting
options.reason: Blocked because this generator is designed to produce deterministic, validated, fail-fast agentic setups.

questions.prompt: Which target agent platforms should be generated?

options.label: OpenCode and VS Code Copilot
options.reason: Recommended because both target adapters are registered and the current bundle already supports both.

options.label: OpenCode only
options.reason: Compatible because the OpenCode target adapter is registered.

options.label: VS Code Copilot only
options.reason: Compatible because the VS Code Copilot target adapter is registered.
